description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - Order under Section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No 11 of 2021 Port City BPO (Private) Limited
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the specification of legal exemptions and incentives under various enactments (Inland Revenue Act, Value Added Tax Act, Customs Ordinance, etc.) for a designated business under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. It constitutes a regulatory matter where the Minister is exercising powers vested by specific legislation to grant statutory exemptions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
